title: Design System: Rizq Khata (public marketing pages)

extensions.scope: Public marketing surfaces only: /, /about, /privacy, /terms (MarketingShell, .rk scope in src/app/globals.css). The dashboard is Operate mode and shares only the brand-50…900 scale and logo files.

display.purpose: Page h1 on Home, About and legal pages. Anek Bangla variable at 650; -0.005em tracking in Bangla, balanced wrap.

headline.purpose: Section h2; the close grows to clamp(2rem, 4.4vw, 3.5rem).

body.purpose: Sub-copy and legal text at 1.02–1.15rem, 34–44rem measure. In Bangla the .rk scope uses Anek Bangla first.

label.purpose: Panel titles, nav, footer heads, button text. Sentence case.

figure.purpose: Amounts and counts in mocks; tabular numerals, localised digits, never rounded.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Floating cards on white: receipt card, demo counter.

shadows.name: on-green
shadows.purpose: White cards sitting on a logo-green field.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Mint 2 background wash on a value that just changed; the value is visible throughout. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: 6px upward settle when the language tile swaps scripts; transform only, no opacity.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover and press on buttons, links and demo tiles; header shadow uses 300ms.

narrative.overview:
The public pages play the category standard straight and at full craft: a modern product page held to Linear/Stripe precision, with the confident local colour of bKash and Pathao. Logo green is not an accent here; it owns whole fields (the hero phone panel, the repair band, the language tile, the close, the About name band) the way a mobile-money brand owns its colour. Everything else sits on white or a very pale green-grey ground, with slate and near-black ink for text.

The product is shown, not described. Every section carries a working fragment of real UI rendered in code (a phone on the Sell screen, the one-sale ledgers, a repair job card, an offline outbox, a money-out list) and every fragment wears a visible "sample data" label. Bangla is the design target; English is a switch, and both scripts must hold the same hierarchy.

Scope. This world governs /, /about, /privacy and /terms, all wrapped in MarketingShell and scoped by the .rk class. The dashboard behind /login is Operate mode: it shares only the brand tokens (the brand-50…900 green scale and the logo files) and keeps its own shadcn/slate system and Tiro Bangla body. Do not carry colour fields, display type, settle motion, phone mocks or marketing shadows into the app; nothing under .rk is used by the dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Logo green owns full-bleed or large rounded colour fields, never just buttons.
White and pale green-grey grounds; 1px hairline rings instead of borders on cards.
Anek Bangla (variable) display at weight 650 in both scripts; Inter for Latin body.
Soft, green-tinted, diffused drop shadows on floating UI only.
Generous radii (16–28px on UI, up to 40px on colour-field panels), pill buttons.
Lucide icons at ~1.75 stroke; tabular figures on every amount.
Values that change settle with a mint wash; they never fade in from nothing.

rules.name: The Owned Field Rule
rules.body: On the selling pages (Home, About) logo green appears as a whole field at least once (hero panel, repair band, About name band, close). A selling page where green is only buttons has lost the world. Legal pages are reading documents: Ground 2 header, green only for links, bullets and the date line.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: The only greens are the logo green family and its mint tints. No other hue competes as a brand colour; stray tints exist only to make sample data look real.

rules.name: The Same Weight Rule
rules.body: Headlines are Anek Bangla 650 in both languages. Never set a display line in Tiro Bangla or let the browser synthesise bold on the public pages.

rules.name: The Exact Taka Rule
rules.body: Every amount uses tabular figures and the localised digit set; amounts are never rounded or compacted.

rules.name: The Ring At Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards and tiles at rest get a 1px Hairline ring, not a shadow. A shadow means the thing is floating above the page.

dos: Do give logo green at least one whole field on every selling page, and put white cards on it with the On Green shadow.
Do label every mock with the sample-data chip; mocks show plausible Bangladeshi shop data in taka.
Do set every headline in Anek Bangla 650 and every amount in tabular figures with localised digits.
Do let changed values settle with the Mint 2 wash, and switch it off under reduced motion.
Do use Lucide icons at 1.75 stroke (up to ~2.25 for tiny check and arrow glyphs).
Do keep the dashboard in its own Operate system; share only the brand scale and logo files.
donts: Don't fade, scale or slide values in from invisible; values in a demo are always on screen.
Don't build icon-tile feature grids; a small icon tile may only head a data panel or list row.
Don't invent proof: no customer logos, testimonials, usage counts or named shops.
Don't use hard, unblurred offset shadows or any non-green tinted shadow.
Don't introduce a second brand hue or use indigo; Amber is reserved for attention states.
Don't use stock photography; the product is shown in code-rendered UI.
